description: Short logic puzzles with known answers.
name: Reasoning

tasks.prompt: All roses are flowers. Some flowers fade quickly. Can we conclude that some roses fade quickly? Answer yes or no.
If today is Wednesday, what day will it be in 10 days? Answer with the day name.
Tom is taller than Dick. Dick is taller than Harry. Who is the shortest?
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 together. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost in cents? Answer with just the number.
Some cats are black, and every black animal in this house is a cat. Does it follow that every cat in this house is black? Answer yes or no.
